# Cademí for developers

> Public issue tracker for the Cademí API v3 and the cademi CLI. The cademi CLI is the command-line tool for the Cademí API v3 (an LMS): every API operation as a command, human or credential sign-in, event forwarding to localhost, declarative configuration, and file transfer. Install with `curl -fsSL https://cli.cademi.dev/install.sh | bash`; authenticate unattended with `CADEMI_API_KEY`; list every command with `cademi commands --brief --json`.

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/minhacademi/developers/blob/main/AGENTS.md): short guide for AI agents (install, auth without a browser, discovery, exit codes, reporting)
- [Overview](https://cademi.dev/cli.md)
